source: Planted bad: a baseline output whose evidence for lines 1 and 3 is replaced with vague text.

lines.line: node bin/greet.js --shout <name> prints Hello, <name>! in upper case, for example HELLO, ADA!
node bin/greet.js <name> without --shout still prints Hello, <name>!
lines.evidence: Tried a build that upper-cases every output, or turns shouting on by default. Running `node bin/greet.js Ada` catches it because it must print 'Hello, Ada!'. The existing 'cli' test in test/greet.test.js checks the same thing. This can be run at the PR commit.

lines.line: The published docs page at https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ documents --shout
lines.evidence: This line might be hard to check and could go wrong in some cases.

result.wrong_build: A PR that adds --shout correctly in bin/greet.js/src/greet.js but documents it only in README.md, or not at all, and leaves docs/index.md unchanged. Lines 1 and 2 pass at the PR commit. Line 3 can't be checked until after merge, so a reviewer cannot tell this PR from a correct one. After merge, the published site at o.github.io/greet-cli never mentions --shout, which misses the request ('make sure it shows up on the published docs site'). An expect line saying docs/index.md documents --shout would catch this before merge.

planted.evidence-grounded: line 1 names no wrong build; line 3 names no concrete reason
planted.catches-traps: nothing points at pages.yml or publish-on-push
